evals.prompt: All my entities went unavailable after I restarted Home Assistant. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Reads config/home-assistant.log and the coordinator before proposing a fix, rather than guessing at code changes.
assertions: Inspects config/home-assistant.log (or the live output) before proposing a fix
Uses ./script/develop rather than a hand-written hass command
Considers the coordinator's first refresh and which exception type it raises

evals.prompt: In _async_update_data, just return None when the API call fails so nothing crashes.
evals.expected_output: Refuses and explains that failure is signalled by raising UpdateFailed or ConfigEntryAuthFailed.
assertions: Explains that returning None is wrong and the coordinator signals failure by raising
Names UpdateFailed for transient failures and ConfigEntryAuthFailed for rejected credentials

evals.prompt: Run pytest and tell me what breaks.
evals.expected_output: Uses script/test instead of invoking pytest directly.
assertions: Runs script/test rather than a bare pytest invocation
